purpose: Verified contract for citizen-readable comparison of two approved timeline events.
scope_rule: Compared events must share a verified property scope unless a separately authorised comparison permits otherwise.
difference_rule: Comparison identifies supported differences and unchanged dimensions; difference alone does not establish causation.
causation_rule: Causal connections require independent evidence and remain explicitly unresolved when unsupported.
date_rule: Event, document, registration and legal-effect dates remain distinct for each event.
interest_rule: Changes are assessed by property-interest dimension and are not collapsed into ownership.
party_rule: Party participation is not automatically a legal role or ownership interest.
temporal_rule: Each event is analysed under the legal version applicable to its relevant date.
privacy_rule: Restricted evidence and private data remain protected.
verification_boundary: Event comparison describes supported relationships and differences; it does not create a new legal conclusion.
